_doc: ROADMAP 7.1n4: mog's CHIP data hunks. S_32 is byte-congruent with program S_27 (zero BSS, 45,744 bytes) and SHARES its object (one chip copy for both overlays; image_tab zeroes it at each entry, exactly what the loader's re-read did); S_35 is the twin of program S_30 (own object: its pointer cells point into mog); S_15 (tile mask buffer, 200 bytes) and S_43 (hardware cursor sprite buffer, 80 bytes) are own chip BSS objects. See program.data_chip.json.
